verdict.rationale: As Merchant of Record, Polar explicitly states it calculates, collects, and remits taxes worldwide, and offers tax-inclusive pricing controls; license-key sales are also noted as tax-handled. This is strong first-party documentation but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of actual tax calculation accuracy across jurisdictions. Missing for 10: independent verification of tax calculation correctness, detail on specific tax regimes/rates supported, and third-party audit of remittance compliance.
